caveats.vacuum_dianion: Post-added fixed-FF ALPB does not polarize the vacuum density; finite-basis SCF convergence does not prove electron binding or ground-state stability.

caveats.force: Native analytic admission only, no finite-difference or force-accuracy qualification. Both Dy MACE force comparisons unavailable; no new MACE requests.
caveats.interpretation: Per-metal deformation works and Dy-minus-La work difference; no absolute cross-method energies, affinity, classifier or preference claims.
